import json,re,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
b=Path("/home/sasaki/datasets/openloris/corridor1-1-m8-bounded-native-v1/tier-5000-slice")
runs={}
for arm in ("boundary-control","boundary-a","boundary-b"):
 log=(b/(arm+".log")).read_text();time=(b/(arm+".time")).read_text()
 assert "Exit status: 0" in time,arm
 hashes={}
 for n in ("cameras.txt","images.txt","points3D.txt"):
  data=(b/arm/"model/component-000"/n).read_bytes()
  hashes[n]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
  ref="legacy" if arm=="boundary-control" else "boundary-a"
  assert data==(b/ref/"model/component-000"/n).read_bytes(),(arm,n)
 result=[l for l in log.splitlines() if l.startswith("rig-multimodel result:")][-1]
 assert "registered_frames=2500/2500 registered_images=5000/5000" in result
 runs[arm]=dict(model_sha256=hashes,mapper_seconds=float(re.search(r"mapper_seconds=([0-9.]+)",result)[1]),peak_rss_kib=int(re.search(r"Maximum resident set size \(kbytes\): (\d+)",time)[1]),added_anchors=len(re.findall(r"^rig-ba-boundary-anchor:",log,re.M)),result=result,time_output=time,log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(log.encode()).hexdigest())
print(json.dumps(dict(control_exact_to_legacy=True,candidate_repeats_exact=True,runs=runs),indent=2))
